name: Aero Pot
description:
Houses a single Plant when sown with a Seed.

Increases Decor even when empty, contributing to Morale.

Must be hung from a ceiling.

name: Airborne Critter Condo
description: A hanging respite area for adult Pufts, Moos and Shine Bugs.

name: Airborne Critter Trap
description:
Attracts and captures airborne Critters.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

name: Airflow Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Blocks Liquid flow without obstructing Gas.

name: Algae Distiller
description: Refines Slime into Algae.

name: Algae Terrarium
description:
Consumes Algae to produce Oxygen and remove some Carbon Dioxide.

Gains a 10% efficiency boost in direct Light.

name: Ancient Specimen
description:
Contains a partial Fossil left behind by a giant critter.

Studying the full skeleton could yield the information required to access a valuable new resource.

name: AND Gate
description:
Outputs a Green Signal when both Input A AND Input B are receiving Green.

Outputs a Red Signal when even one Input is receiving Red.

name: Anti Entropy Thermo-Nullifier
description:
A self-sustaining machine powered by what appears to be refined Neutronium.

Absorbs and neutralizes Heat energy when provided with piped Hydrogen Gas.

name: Apothecary
description:
Produces Medicine to cure most basic Diseases.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding Skill to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Aquatic Critter Condo
description: A fancy respite area for adult Critters who live in Liquid pools.

name: Aquatic Critter Fountain
description:
Dispenses Brackene or Squid Ink to aquatic Critters.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves Critters' moods.

name: Aquatic Grooming Station
description:
Allows the assigned Rancher to care for and gradually tame Critters.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the Critter Ranching and Basic Swimming skills.

name: Aquatic Milking Station
description:
Extracts Ovolene or Squid Ink from eligible aquatic Critters.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the Critter Ranching II and Basic Swimming skills.

name: Aquatic Shearing Station
description:
Allows eligible aquatic Critters to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the Critter Ranching and Basic Swimming skills.

name: Arcade Cabinet
description:
Allows Duplicants to play video games on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Artifact Analysis Station
description: Analyses and extracts Neutronium from artifacts of interest.

name: Atmo Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Gas pressure enters the chosen range.

name: Atmo Suit Checkpoint
description:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Atmo Suits.

Must be built next to an Atmo Suit Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Atmo Suit Dock
description:
Stores Atmo Suits and refuels them with Oxygen.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to an Atmo Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: Auto-Sweeper
description:
Automates Sweeping and Supplying errands by sucking up all nearby Debris.

Materials are automatically delivered to any Conveyor Loader, Conveyor Receptacle, storage, or buildings within range.

name: Automated Notifier
description:
Attach to sensors to send a notification when certain conditions are met.

Notifications can be customized.

name: Automatic Dispenser
description:
Stores any Solid Materials delivered to it by Duplicants.

Dumps stored materials back into the world when it receives a Green Signal.

name: Automation Broadcaster
description:
Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal to an Automation Receiver over vast distances in space.

Both the Automation Broadcaster and the Automation Receiver must be exposed to space to function.

name: Automation Receiver
description:
Receives a Green Signal or a Red Signal from an Automation Broadcaster over vast distances in space.

Both the Automation Receiver and the Automation Broadcaster must be exposed to space to function.

name: Automation Ribbon
description:
A 4-Bit Automation Wire which can carry up to four automation signals.

Use a Ribbon Writer to output to multiple Bits, and a Ribbon Reader to input from multiple Bits.

name: Automation Ribbon Bridge
description:
Runs one Automation Ribbon section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Automation Wire
description:
Connects buildings to Sensors.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Automation Wire Bridge
description:
Runs one Automation Wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Battery
description:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Loses charge over time.

name: Beach Chair
description:
Duplicants can relax by lounging in Sunlight.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Biodiesel Engine
description:
Burns Biodiesel to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Biodiesel Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Blank Canvas
description:
Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: Blastshot Maker
description:
Produces Blastshot from Refined Metals combined with Petroleum.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Bleach Stone Hopper
description: Uses Salt and Gold to produce Bleach Stone.

name: Botanical Analyzer
description: Identifies new Seed subspecies.

name: Bottle Drainer
description: Drains bottled Liquids into Liquid Pipes.

name: Bottle Emptier
description: Empties bottled Liquids back into the world.

name: Bottle Filler
description: Automatically stores piped Liquids into bottles for manual transport.

name: Breathing Station
description: Provides breathable Oxygen to Duplicants in suffocating environments via a connected Gas Pipe input.

name: BUFFER Gate
description:
Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Green Signal.

Continues sending a Green Signal for an amount of buffer time after the Input receives a Red Signal.

name: Bunker Door
description:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Can withstand extremely high pressures and impacts.

name: Bunker Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Can withstand extreme pressures and impacts.

name: Canister Drainer
description: Drains Gas canisters into Gas Pipes.

name: Canister Emptier
description: Empties Gas canisters back into the world.

name: Canister Filler
description: Automatically stores piped Gases into canisters for manual transport.

name: Carbon Dioxide Engine
description:
Uses pressurized Carbon Dioxide to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Carbon Dioxide Engines are relatively fast engine for their size but with limited height restrictions.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Carbon Skimmer
description: Uses Water to filter Carbon Dioxide from the air.

name: Carpeted Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

name: Ceiling Light
description:
Provides Light when Powered.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: Ceiling Trim
description:
Used to decorate the ceilings of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

name: Clothing Refashionator
description:
Upgrades Snazzy Suits into Primo Garb.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Coal Generator
description:
Converts Coal into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide.

name: Comfy Bed
description:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and restores additional stamina.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.

name: Communal Table
description:
Gives three Duplicants a place to eat.

Sharing a meal with one or more companions provides a Morale boost.

name: Compact Discharger
description: Converts stored energy from Power Banks into power for connected buildings.

name: Compost
description: Reduces Polluted Dirt, rotting Foods, and discarded organics down into Dirt.

name: Conduction Panel
description:
Carries Liquid, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with overlapping buildings.

Can function in a vacuum.

Can be run through wall and floor tiles.

name: Conductive Wire
description:
Connects buildings to Power sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conductive Wire Bridge
description:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Wire Bridge without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conveyor Bridge
description:
Runs one Conveyor Rail section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conveyor Chute
description: Unloads Solid Materials from a Conveyor Rail onto the floor.

name: Conveyor Loader
description:
Loads Solid Materials onto Conveyor Rail for transport.

Only loads the resources of my choosing.

name: Conveyor Loader Fitting
description:
Allows Solid Materials to be moved out of rocket storage via Conveyor Rails.

Draws solid material from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Conveyor Meter
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn material transfer off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: Conveyor Rail
description:
Transports Solid Materials on a track between Conveyor Loader and Conveyor Receptacle.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conveyor Rail Element Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal when the selected item is detected on a rail.

name: Conveyor Rail Germ Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the object on the rail.

name: Conveyor Rail Thermo Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when rail contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: Conveyor Receptacle
description: Unloads Solid Materials from a Conveyor Rail into storage.

name: Conveyor Receptacle Fitting
description:
Allows Solid Materials to be moved into rocket storage via Conveyor Rails.

Sends solid material to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Conveyor Shutoff
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Solid Material transport on or off.

name: Cooking Tools
description:
Increases the speed at which nearby cooking stations complete orders.

This building does not require Duplicant operation.

name: Corner Trim
description:
Used to decorate the ceiling corners of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

name: Cot
description:
Gives one Duplicant a place to sleep.

Duplicants will automatically return to their cots to sleep at night.

name: Crafting Station
description:
Produces items and equipment for Duplicant use.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Critter Condo
description: Provides a comfortable lounge area that boosts domesticated Critters' happiness.

name: Critter Drop-Off
description:
Releases trapped Critters back into the world.

Monitoring and drop-off are limited to the specified species.

name: Critter Feeder
description: Automatically dispenses food for hungry Critters.

name: Critter Fountain
description:
Dispenses Brackene or Squid Ink to a wide variety of Critters.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves Critters' moods.

name: Critter Pick-Up
description:
Ensures the prompt relocation of Critters that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.

name: Critter Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the number of eggs and critters in a room.

name: Critter Trap
description:
Captures a living Critter for transport.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

name: Cycle Sensor
description: Sets an automatic Green Signal and Red Signal schedule within one day-night cycle.

name: Data Miner
description:
Mass-produces Data Banks that can be processed into Data Analysis Research points.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Decontamination Shower
description:
Uses Water to remove Germs and Radiation.

Decontaminates both Duplicants and their Clothing.

name: Deep Fryer
description:
Uses Tallow to cook a wide variety of improved Foods.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Dehydrator
description:
Uses low, even heat to eliminate moisture from eligible Foods and render them shelf-stable.

Dehydrated meals must be processed at the Rehydrator before they can be eaten.

name: Deodorizer
description: Uses Sand to filter Polluted Oxygen from the air, reducing Disease spread.

name: Desalinator
description: Removes Salt from Brine or Salt Water, producing Water.

name: Dev Generator
description: Generates testing power for late nights.

name: Dev Heater
description: Generates on-demand heat for testing toastiness.

name: Dev Life Support
description: Generates warm, oxygen-rich air.

name: Dev Light Source
description: Generates dimmable light on demand.

name: Dev Pump Gas
description:
Draws in Gas and runs it through Pipes.

Must be immersed in Gas.

name: Dev Pump Liquid
description:
Draws in Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

name: Dev Pump Solid
description: Generates chosen Solid Materials and runs it through Conveyor Rail

name: Dev Radbolt Generator
description: Generates Radbolts.

name: Dev Radiation Emitter
description: Generates on-demand radiation to keep things clear. Nu-clear.

name: Diamond Press
description:
Crushes Refined Carbon into Diamond, and Coquina into Pearl.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued and ingredients have been discovered.

name: Disease Clinic
description:
Allows Duplicants to administer powerful treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Advanced Medical Care Skill to treat peers.

name: Display Shelf
description:
Displays cherished items and increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be installed on a back wall.

name: Drywall
description:
Prevents Gas and Liquid loss in space.

Builds an insulating backwall behind buildings.

name: Duplicant Checkpoint
description:
Allows Duplicants to pass when receiving a Green Signal.

Prevents Duplicants from passing when receiving a Red Signal.

name: Duplicant Motion Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on whether a Duplicant is in the sensor's range.

name: Egg Cracker
description:
Converts viable Critter eggs into cooking ingredients.

Cracked Eggs cannot hatch.

Duplicants will not crack eggs unless tasks are queued.

name: Electric Grill
description:
Cooks a wide variety of improved Foods.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Electrolyzer
description:
Converts Water into Oxygen and Hydrogen Gas.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Emulsifier
description:
Combines Liquids and other inputs into fluid compounds.

Duplicants will not fabricate emulsions unless recipes are queued.

name: Enclosed Telescope
description:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space and produces Data Banks... in comfort!

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy skill.

Excellent sunburn protection (100%), partial Radiation protection (50%) .

Building must be exposed to space to function.

name: Espresso Machine
description:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Ethanol Distiller
description: Refines Wood into Ethanol.

name: Exosuit Forge
description:
Forges protective Exosuits for Duplicants to wear.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Farm Station
description:
Produces Micronutrient Fertilizer to increase Plant growth rates.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Crop Tending trait.

This building is a necessary component of the Greenhouse room.

name: Farm Tile
description:
Grows one Plant from a Seed.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

name: Fertilizer Synthesizer
description: Uses Polluted Water and Phosphorite to produce Fertilizer.

name: FILTER Gate
description:
Only lets a Green Signal through if the Input has received a Green Signal for longer than the selected filter time.

Will continue outputting a Red Signal if the Green Signal did not last long enough.

name: Fire Pole
description:
Allows rapid Duplicant descent.

Significantly slows upward climbing.

name: Fish Feeder
description:
Automatically dispenses stored Critter food into the area below.

Dispenses continuously as food is consumed.

name: Fish Pick-Up
description:
Ensures the prompt capture of aquatic Critters that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.

Must be built above a Liquid pool.

name: Fish Release
description:
Releases trapped aquatic critters back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.

name: Fish Trap
description:
Attracts and traps aquatic Critters.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

name: Flower Pot
description:
Houses a single Plant when sown with a Seed.

Increases Decor when in use, contributing to Morale.

name: Forge Tools
description:
Increases the fabrication speed for compatible buildings placed nearby.

This building does not require Duplicant operation.

name: Fossil Block
description:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Gantry
description: Provides scaffolding across rocket modules to allow Duplicant access.

name: Gas Bridge
description:
Runs one Gas Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Gas Element Sensor
description:
Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected on this sensor's tile.

Sends a Red Signal when the selected Gas is not present.

name: Gas Filter
description: Sieves one Gas from the air, sending it into a dedicated Pipe.

name: Gas Intake Fitting
description:
Allows Gases to be pumped into rocket storage via Pipes.

Sends gas to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Gas Meter Valve
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Gas flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: Gas Output Fitting
description:
Allows Gases to be drawn from rocket storage via Pipes.

Draws gas from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Gas Pipe
description:
Carries Gas between Outputs and Intakes.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Gas Pipe Element Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected within a pipe.

name: Gas Pipe Germ Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.

name: Gas Pipe Thermo Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: Gas Pump
description:
Draws in Gas and runs it through Pipes.

Must be immersed in Gas.

name: Gas Range
description:
Cooks a wide variety of quality Foods.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Gas Reservoir
description: Stores any Gas resources piped into it.

name: Gas Rocket Port Loader
description:
Loads Gases to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the gas filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

name: Gas Rocket Port Unloader
description:
Unloads Gases from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the gas filters set on this unloader.

name: Gas Shutoff
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Gas flow on or off.

name: Gas Valve
description: Controls the Gas volume permitted through Pipes.

name: Gas Vent
description: Releases Gas from Gas Pipes.

name: Geotuner
description:
Increases the Temperature and output of an analyzed Geyser.

Multiple Geotuners can be directed at a single Geyser anywhere on an asteroid.

name: Germ Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on quantity of surrounding Germs.

name: Glass Backwall
description:
Prevents Gas and Liquid loss in space.

Builds a transparent backwall behind buildings.

Provides higher Decor than standard drywall.

name: Glass Forge
description:
Produces Molten Glass from raw Sand.

Outputs High Temperature Liquid.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Glass Jelly Ceiling Light
description:
Provides Light when Powered.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: Gleaner
description: Refines Brackene into Brine and Brackwax, and Ovolene into Caviar and Mucin.

name: Grooming Station
description:
Allows the assigned Rancher to care for and gradually tame Critters.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Critter Ranching skill.

name: Gunk Extractor
description: Cleanses stale Gunk build-up from Duplicants' bionic parts.

name: Hammer
description:
In its default orientation, the hammer strikes the building to the left when it receives a Green Signal.

Each building has a unique sound when struck by the hammer.

The hammer does no damage when it strikes.

name: Hand Sanitizer
description:
Removes most Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Hand Sanitizers when passing by in the selected direction.

name: Hanging Fossil Block
description:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Hanging Pot
description:
Houses a single Plant when sown with a Seed.

Increases Decor when in use, contributing to Morale.

Must be hung from a ceiling.

name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Joint Plate
description:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Heavi-Watt Joint Plate without overloading.

Allows Heavi-Watt Wire to be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Wire
description:
Carries more Wattage than regular Wire without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Joint Plate
description:
Allows Heavi-Watt Wire to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Wire
description:
Carries more Wattage than regular Wire without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

name: High Pressure Gas Vent
description: Releases Gas from Gas Pipes into high pressure locations.

name: Hot Tub
description:
Requires Pipes to and from tub and Power to run the jets.

Water must be a comfortable temperature and will cool rapidly.

Increases Duplicant Morale and leaves them feeling deliciously warm.

name: Hydro Sensor
description:
Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Liquid pressure enters the chosen range.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

name: Hydrogen Engine
description:
Burns Liquid Hydrogen to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Hydrogen Engines have the same generous height restrictions as Petroleum Engines but are slightly faster.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Hydrogen Generator
description: Converts Hydrogen Gas into electrical Power.

name: Hydroponic Farm
description:
Grows one Plant from a Seed.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

Some plants must be irrigated through Liquid Piping.

name: Ice Block
description:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Ice Liquefier
description: Consumes Wood to melt Ice into Water, which can be bottled for transport.

name: Ice Maker
description: Converts Water into Ice or Snow.

name: Ice-E Fan
description: Uses Ice to dissipate a small amount of the Heat.

name: Incubator
description:
Incubates Critter eggs until ready to hatch.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Critter Ranching skill.

name: Insulated Conductive Wire
description:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Conductive Wire without overloading.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Conductive Wire Bridge
description:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Conductive Wire Bridge without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Door
description: Significantly reduces Temperature exchange between climate-controlled rooms.

name: Insulated Gas Pipe
description:
Carries Gas with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Liquid Pipe
description:
Carries Liquid with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Reduces Heat transfer between walls, retaining ambient heat in an area.

name: Interplanetary Launcher
description:
Launches Interplanetary Payloads between Planetoids.

Payloads can contain Solid, Liquid, or Gas materials.

Cannot transport Duplicants.

name: Jet Suit Checkpoint
description:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Jet Suits.

Must be built next to a Jet Suit Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Jet Suit Dock
description:
Stores Jet Suits and refuels them with Oxygen and Combustible Liquid.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to a Jet Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: Juicer
description:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Drinking juice increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Jukebot
description:
Plays music for Duplicants to dance to on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Jumbo Battery
description:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Slightly loses charge over time.

name: Kiln
description:
Fires Clay to produce Ceramic, and Coal or Wood to produce Refined Carbon.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Ladder
description: Enables vertical mobility for Duplicants.

name: Ladder Bed
description:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and also functions as a ladder.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.

name: Lamp
description:
Provides Light when Powered.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: Landscape Canvas
description:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: Large Discharger
description: Efficiently converts stored energy from Power Banks into power for connected buildings.

name: Large Power Transformer
description:
Limits Power flowing through the Transformer to 4 kW.

Connect Batteries on the large side to act as a valve and prevent Wires from drawing more than 4 kW.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Large Sculpting Block
description:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Lavatory
description:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Spreads very few Germs.

name: Lead Suit Checkpoint
description:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Lead Suits.

Must be built next to a Lead Suit Dock

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Lead Suit Dock
description:
Stores Lead Suits and refuels them with Oxygen.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to a Lead Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: Light Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Brightness enters the chosen range.

name: Liquid Bridge
description:
Runs one Liquid Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Liquid Element Sensor
description:
Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected on this sensor's tile.

Sends a Red Signal when the selected Liquid is not present.

name: Liquid Filter
description:
Sieves one Liquid out of a mix, sending it into a dedicated Filtered Output Pipe.

Can only filter one liquid type at a time.

name: Liquid Intake Fitting
description:
Allows Liquids to be pumped into rocket storage via Pipes.

Sends liquid to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Liquid Meter Valve
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Liquid flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: Liquid Output Fitting
description:
Allows Liquids to be drawn from rocket storage via Pipes.

Draws liquid from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Liquid Pipe
description:
Carries Liquid between Outputs and Intakes.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Liquid Pipe Element Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected within a pipe.

name: Liquid Pipe Germ Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.

name: Liquid Pipe Thermo Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: Liquid Pump
description:
Draws in Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

name: Liquid Reservoir
description: Stores any Liquid resources piped into it.

name: Liquid Rocket Port Loader
description:
Loads Liquids to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the liquid filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

name: Liquid Rocket Port Unloader
description:
Unloads Liquids from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the liquid filters set on this unloader.

name: Liquid Shutoff
description: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Liquid flow on or off.

name: Liquid Tepidizer
description:
Warms large bodies of Liquid.

Must be fully submerged.

name: Liquid Valve
description: Controls the Liquid volume permitted through Pipes.

name: Liquid Vent
description: Releases Liquid from Liquid Pipes.

name: Lubrication Station
description: Uses Gear Oil to keep Duplicants' bionic parts running smoothly.

name: Manual Airlock
description:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

name: Manual Generator
description: Converts manual labor into electrical Power.

name: Manual Radbolt Generator
description:
Refines radioactive ores to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of my choosing.

name: Marble Block
description:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Marine Drill
description:
Removes mineral build-up from underwater vents to restore the flow of Gases.

Must be built on top of a vent or fissure.

name: Massage Table
description:
Rapidly reduces Stress for the Duplicant user.

Duplicants will automatically seek a massage table when Stress exceeds breaktime range.

name: Materials Study Terminal
description:
Conducts Materials Science Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Radbolts.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Applied Sciences Research skill.

name: Mechanical Surfboard
description:
Increases Duplicant Morale.

Some Water gets splashed on the floor during use.

name: Mechanized Airlock
description:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Functions as a Manual Airlock when no Power is available.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

name: Memory Toggle
description:
Contains an internal Memory, and will output whatever signal is stored in that Memory.

Signals sent to the Inputs only affect the Memory, and do not pass through to the Output. 

Sending a Green Signal to the Set Port (S) will set the memory to Green. 

Sending a Green Signal to the Reset Port (R) will reset the memory back to Red.

name: Mercury Ceiling Light
description:
Uses Mercury and Power to produce Light.

Light reduces Duplicant stress and is required to grow certain plants.

name: Mesh Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Does not obstruct Liquid or Gas flow.

name: Mess Table
description:
Gives one Duplicant a place to eat.

Duplicants will automatically eat at their assigned table when hungry.

name: Metal Block
description:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Metal Refinery
description:
Produces Refined Metals from raw Metal Ore.

Significantly Heats and outputs the Liquid piped into it.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Metal Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: Meteor Blaster
description:
Fires explosive projectiles at incoming space objects to defend the colony from impact-related damage.

Projectiles must be crafted at a Blastshot Maker.

Range: 16 tiles horizontally, 32 tiles vertically.

name: Microbe Musher
description:
Produces low quality Food using common ingredients.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Milking Station
description: Allows Duplicants with the Critter Ranching II skill to milk Moos for  Brackene or  Biodiesel.

name: Mini Fridge
description: Stores Food at an ideal Temperature to prevent spoilage.

name: Mini Gas Pump
description:
Draws in a small amount of Gas and runs it through Pipes.

Must be immersed in Gas.

name: Mini Liquid Pump
description:
Draws in a small amount of Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

name: Mini-Pod
description:
A portable bioprinter that produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

Only one Printing Pod or Mini-Pod is permitted per Planetoid.

name: Mission Control Station
description:
Provides guidance data to rocket pilots within range, to improve rocket speed.

Must be operated by a Duplicant with the Astronomy skill.

Requires a clear line of sight to space in order to function.

name: Molecular Forge
description:
Processes Rare Materials into advanced industrial goods.

Rare materials can be retrieved from space missions.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Monument Base
description:
Builds the bottom section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.

name: Monument Midsection
description:
Builds the middle section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.

name: Monument Top
description:
Builds the top section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.

name: Natural Gas Generator
description:
Converts Natural Gas into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

name: NOT Gate
description:
Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Red Signal.

Outputs a Red Signal when its Input is receiving a Green Signal.

name: Oil Refinery
description: Converts Crude Oil into Petroleum and Natural Gas.

name: Oil Well
description:
Extracts Crude Oil using clean Water.

Must be built atop an Oil Reservoir.

name: OR Gate
description:
Outputs a Green Signal if at least one of Input A OR Input B is receiving Green.

Outputs a Red Signal when neither Input A or Input B are receiving Green.

name: Orbital Data Collection Lab
description:
Creates Data Banks that can be consumed at a Virtual Planetarium to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Plastic and Power.

name: Ore Scrubber
description: Kills a significant amount of Germs present on Raw Ore.

name: Outhouse
description:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Requires no Piping.

Must be periodically emptied of Polluted Dirt.

name: Oxygen Diffuser
description:
Converts large amounts of Algae into Oxygen.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Oxygen Mask Checkpoint
description:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off an Oxygen Mask.

Must be built next to an Oxygen Mask Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Oxygen Mask Dock
description:
Stores Oxygen Masks and refuels them with Oxygen.

Build next to an Oxygen Mask Checkpoint to make Duplicants put on masks when passing by.

name: Oxylite Refinery
description: Synthesizes Oxylite using Oxygen and a small amount of Gold.

name: Oxylite Sconce
description: Stores a small chunk of Oxylite which gradually releases Oxygen into the environment.

name: Park Sign
description: Classifies an area as a Park or Nature Reserve.

name: Party Line Phone
description:
Can be used by one Duplicant to chat with themselves or with other Duplicants in different locations.

Chatting increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Payload Opener
description:
Unpacks Interplanetary Payloads delivered by Duplicants.

Automatically separates Solid, Liquid, and Gas materials and distributes them to the appropriate systems.

name: Peat Burner
description:
Burns Peat to produce electrical Power.

Produces a small amount of Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

name: Pedestal
description:
Displays a single object, doubling its Decor value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.

name: Petroleum Engine
description:
Burns Petroleum to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Petroleum Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Petroleum Generator
description:
Converts Petroleum, Ethanol or Biodiesel into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

name: Pitcher Pump
description:
Manually pumps Liquid into bottles for transport.

Duplicants can only carry liquids that are bottled.

name: Pixel Pack
description:
Pixels can be designated a color when it receives a Green Signal and a different color when it receives a Red Signal.

Input from an Automation Wire controls the whole strip. Input from an Automation Ribbon can control individual pixels on the strip.

name: Plant Pulverizer
description:
Crushes organic materials to extract liquids such as Brackene or Phyto Oil.

Brackene can be used to refill the Critter Fountain.

name: Planter Box
description: Grows one Plant from a Seed.

name: Plastic Ladder
description: Increases Duplicant climbing speed.

name: Plastic Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: Plywood Press
description: Combines Resin and Plant Husk to create Plywood.

name: Pneumatic Door
description:
Encloses areas without blocking Liquid or Gas flow.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

name: Polymer Press
description: Converts Plastic Monomers into raw Plastic.

name: Portrait Canvas
description:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: Power Bank Charger
description: Converts empty Eco Power Banks into fully charged units ready for reuse.

name: Power Control Station
description:
Produces Microchip to increase the Power output of generators.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Tune Up trait.

name: Power Outlet Fitting
description:
Provides Power to connected buildings.

Pulls power from Battery Modules and Rocket Engines.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Power Shutoff
description:
Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Power on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: Power Transformer
description:
Limits Power flowing through the Transformer to 1000 W.

Connect Batteries on the large side to act as a valve and prevent Wires from drawing more than 1000 W.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Radbolt Chamber
description:
Stores Radbolts in a high-energy state, ready for transport.

Requires a Green Signal to release radbolts from storage when the Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts in storage will rapidly decay while this building is disabled.

name: Radbolt Engine
description:
Injects Radbolts into a reaction chamber to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Radbolt Engines are faster than Hydrogen Engines but with a more restrictive height allowance.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Radbolt Generator
description:
Attracts nearby Radiation to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of my choosing when the set Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts collected will gradually decay while this building is disabled.

name: Radbolt Joint Plate
description: Receives Radbolts from Radbolt Generators and directs them through walls. All other materials and elements will be blocked from passage.

name: Radbolt Reflector
description: Receives and redirects Radbolts from Radbolt Generators.

name: Radbolt Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Radbolts detected enters the chosen range.

name: Radiant Gas Pipe
description:
Carries Gas, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Radiant Liquid Pipe
description:
Carries Liquid, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Radiation Lamp
description: Emits Radiation when Powered that can be collected by a Radbolt Generator.

name: Radiation Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Radiation enters the chosen range.

name: Ration Box
description:
Stores a small amount of Food.

Food must be delivered to boxes by Duplicants.

name: Refrigerator
description: Stores Food at an ideal Temperature to prevent spoilage.

name: Rehydrator
description: Restores moisture to convert shelf-stable packaged meals into edible Food.

name: Remote Controller
description: Enables Duplicants to operate machinery remotely via a connected Remote Worker Dock.

name: Remote Worker Dock
description:
Remote Worker Docks deploy automatons that operate machinery based on instructions received from a connected Remote Controller.

Must be placed within range of its target building.

name: Research Reactor
description:
Uses Enriched Uranium to produce Radiation for Radbolt production.

Generates a massive amount of Heat. Overheating will result in an explosive meltdown.

name: Research Station
description:
Conducts Novice Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Dirt.

name: Ribbon Reader
description: Reads a Green Signal or a Red Signal from the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon onto an Automation Wire.

name: Ribbon Writer
description:
Writes a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon

Automation Ribbon must be used as the output wire to avoid overloading.

name: Robo-Miner
description: Automatically digs out all materials in a set range.

name: Rock Crusher
description:
Inefficiently produces refined materials from raw resources.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Rocket Control Station
description:
Allows Duplicants to use pilot-operated rockets and control access to interior buildings.

Assigned Duplicants must have the Rocket Piloting skill.

name: Rocket Platform
description:
Precursor to construction of all other Rocket modules.

Allows Rockets to launch from or land on the host Planetoid.

Automatically links up to Rocket Ports built to either side of the platform.

name: Rocket Port Extension
description: Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or any Rocket Port.

name: Rubber Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides an anti-slip work surface and effective Insulation.

name: Rust Deoxidizer
description:
Converts Rust into Oxygen and Chlorine Gas.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Sandpit
description:
Allows Duplicants to enjoy a Morale-boosting play session on their breaks.

No artistic skill is required.

name: Sauna
description:
Uses Steam to create a relaxing atmosphere.

Increases Duplicant Morale and provides a lingering sense of warmth.

name: Sculpting Block
description:
Minorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Shearing Station
description:
Shearing stations allow eligible Critters to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Visiting this building restores Critters' physical and emotional well-being.

name: Shower
description: Improves Duplicant Morale and removes surface Germs.

name: Sick Bay
description:
Allows Duplicants to administer basic treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Bedside Manner Skill to treat peers.

name: Signal Counter
description:
Counts how many times a Green Signal has been received up to a chosen number.

When the chosen number is reached it sends a Green Signal until it receives another Green Signal, when it resets automatically and begins counting again.

name: Signal Distributor
description:
Route a single Input signal out one of four possible Outputs, based on the selection made by the Control Inputs.

Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Output is selected.

name: Signal Selector
description:
Select which one of four Input signals should be sent out the Output, using Control Inputs.

Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Input is selected.

name: Signal Switch
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal on an Automation grid.

name: Sink
description:
Removes Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Sinks when passing by in the selected direction.

name: Skill Scrubber
description:
Refunds a Duplicant's Skill Points for reassignment.

Duplicants will lose all assigned skills in the process.

name: Sludge Press
description:
Separates Mud and other sludges into their base elements.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Small Petroleum Engine
description:
Burns Petroleum to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Small Petroleum Engines possess the same speed as a Petroleum Engines but have smaller height restrictions.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Smart Battery
description:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Sends a Green Signal or Red Signal based on the configuration of the Logic Activation Parameters.

Very slightly loses charge over time.

name: Smart Storage Bin
description:
Stores the Solid Materials of my choosing.

Sends a Green Signal when contents surpass specified thresholds.

name: Smoker
description:
Cooks improved foods over low, slow heat.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Snow Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Insulates rooms to reduce Heat loss in cold climates.

name: Soda Fountain
description:
Creates soda from Water and Carbon Dioxide.

Consuming soda water increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Solar Panel
description:
Converts Sunlight into electrical Power.

Must be exposed to space.

name: Soldering Station
description:
Produces advanced electronics and bionic Boosters.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Solid Filter
description: Separates one Solid Material from the conveyor, sending it into a dedicated Conveyor Rail.

name: Solid Rocket Port Loader
description:
Loads Solids to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the solid material filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

name: Solid Rocket Port Unloader
description:
Unloads Solids from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the solid material filters set on this unloader.

name: Somnium Synthesizer
description:
An organic multi-cortex repository and processing system fuelled by Oxygen.

Analyzes Dream Journals produced by Duplicants wearing Pajamas.

Provides a sustainable boost to Duplicant skills and abilities throughout the colony.

name: Space Heater
description:
Radiates a moderate amount of Heat.

Requires Power in order to function.

name: Space Racer
description:
Must be connected to a Power source.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

name: Space Scanner
description:
Sends a Green Signal to its automation circuit when it detects incoming objects from space.

Can be configured to detect incoming meteor showers or returning space rockets.

name: Spice Grinder
description: Produces ingredients that add benefits to foods prepared at skilled cooking stations.

name: Starmap Location Sensor
description: Send Green Signals at the chosen Starmap locations and Red Signals everywhere else.

name: Steam Engine
description:
Utilizes Steam to propel rockets for space exploration.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Steam Turbine
description:
Draws in Steam from the tiles directly below the machine's foundation and uses it to generate electrical Power.

Outputs Water.

name: Storage Bin
description: Stores the Solid Materials of my choosing.

name: Storage Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides built-in storage for small spaces.

name: Study Tools
description:
Provides a small increase to Research speed at compatible buildings.

This building does not require Duplicant operation.

name: Sublimation Station
description:
Speeds up the conversion of Polluted Dirt into Polluted Oxygen.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Sugar Engine
description:
Burns Sucrose to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Sugar Engines have higher height restrictions than Carbon Dioxide Engines, but move slower.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires a Large Solid Oxidizer Tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Sun Lamp
description:
Gives off Sunlight level Lux.

Can be paired with Beach Chairs.

name: Super Computer
description:
Conducts Advanced Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Water.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Advanced Research skill.

name: Sushi Bar
description:
Prepares a variety of Uncooked Seafood.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Sweepy's Dock
description:
Deploys an automated Sweepy Bot to sweep up Solid debris and Liquid spills.

Dock stores Liquids and Solids gathered by the Sweepy.

Uses Power to recharge the Sweepy.

Duplicants will empty Dock storage into available storage bins.

name: Switch
description:
Turns Power on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: Targeting Beacon
description:
Guides Interplanetary Payloads and Orbital Cargo Modules to land nearby.

Interplanetary Payloads must be launched from a Interplanetary Launcher.

name: Tasteful Memorial
description:
Provides a final resting place for deceased Duplicants.

Living Duplicants will automatically place an unburied corpse inside.

name: Telescope
description:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space, producing Data Banks in the process.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy skill.

Building must be exposed to space to function.

name: Tempshift Plate
description:
Accelerates or buffers Heat dispersal based on the construction material used.

Has a small area of effect.

name: Textile Loom
description:
Tailors Duplicant Clothing items.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Thermo Aquatuner
description: Cools the Liquid piped through it, but outputs Heat in its immediate vicinity.

name: Thermo Regulator
description: Cools the Gas piped through it, but outputs Heat in its immediate vicinity.

name: Thermo Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Temperature enters the chosen range.

name: Tidal Turbine
description: Converts the kinetic energy from a Tidal Spring below it into electrical Power.

name: Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: Timer Sensor
description: Creates a timer to send Green Signals and Red Signals for specific amounts of time.

name: Trampoline
description:
Uses Rubber to help Duplicants rebound from the stress of colony life.

Increases Duplicant Morale and improves their athleticism.

name: Transit Tube
description:
Quickly transports Duplicants from a Transit Tube Access to the tube's end.

Only transports Duplicants.

name: Transit Tube Access
description:
Allows Duplicants to enter the connected Transit Tube system.

Stops drawing Power once fully charged.

name: Transit Tube Crossing
description:
Allows Transit Tubes to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

name: Triage Cot
description:
Accelerates Health restoration and the healing of physical injuries.

Revives incapacitated Duplicants.

name: Uranium Centrifuge
description:
Extracts Enriched Uranium from Uranium Ore.

Outputs Depleted Uranium in molten form.

name: Vertical Wind Tunnel
description:
Must be connected to a Power Source. To properly function, the area under this building must be left vacant.

Increases Duplicants Morale.

name: Virtual Planetarium
description:
Conducts Data Analysis Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Data Banks generated by exploration.

name: Vulcanizer
description:
Converts Latex into Rubber.

Latex must be delivered via Liquid Pipes.

name: Wall Planter
description:
Grows one extra-large aquatic Plant from a Seed.

It also doubles as a wall tile.

name: Wall Pot
description:
Houses a single Plant when sown with a Seed.

Increases Decor when in use, contributing to Morale.

Must be hung from a wall.

name: Wall Toilet
description:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves. Empties directly on the other side of the wall.

Spreads very few Germs.

name: Wash Basin
description:
Removes some Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Wash Basins when passing by in the selected direction.

name: Water Cooler
description:
Provides a gathering place for Duplicants during Downtime.

Improves Duplicant Morale and relieves Thirst.

name: Water Sieve
description:
Produces clean Water from Polluted Water using Sand.

Produces Polluted Dirt.

name: Wattage Sensor
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Wattage consumed enters the chosen range.

name: Weight Plate
description:
Sends a Green Signal when an object or Duplicant is placed atop of it.

Cannot be triggered by Gas or Liquids.

name: Wicker Door
description:
Encloses areas without blocking Liquid or Gas flow.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

name: Wide Hydroponic Farm
description:
Grows one extra-large Plant from a Seed.

Can be used as floor tile.

Some plants must be irrigated through Liquid Piping.

name: Window Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Allows Light and Decor to pass through.

name: Wire
description:
Connects buildings to Power sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Wire Bridge
description:
Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Wood Block
description:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Wood Burner
description:
Burns Lumber to produce electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Heat.

name: Wood Heater
description: Consumes Wood in order to Heat chilly surroundings.

name: Wood Tile
description:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides good insulation and boosts Decor, contributing to Morale.

name: Workshop Tools
description:
Increases the fabrication speed for compatible buildings placed nearby.

This building does not require Duplicant operation.

name: XOR Gate
description:
Outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving Green.

Outputs a Red Signal if both or neither Inputs are receiving a Green Signal.
